name: Exmouth Adventure Co
summary: Small-group sea kayak and snorkel tours on Ningaloo Reef, run from Exmouth in Western Australia. Trips range from half day paddles to camping expeditions of three to five days, with guided beach snorkelling and a gorge and boat day in Cape Range National Park. A sea kayak expedition in the Dampier Archipelago near Karratha runs in the cooler months.
standouts: Running sea kayak tours on Ningaloo since 1999, first as Capricorn Seakayaking
Strict ratio of 1 guide to 8 guests on adventure tours
Displays a Sustainable Tourism Accredited business logo
Dampier expedition opens with a cultural awareness session and rock art tour led by Murujuga Aboriginal Corporation rangers

contact.address: 24 Pelias St, Exmouth WA 6707 (postal: PO Box 796, Exmouth WA 6707)

trips.title: Turtle Tour
trips.summary: A half day paddle and snorkel in the Bundegi Sanctuary Zone in Exmouth Gulf, at the northern end of Ningaloo Reef. Guests paddle double sit-on-top kayaks looking for turtles, rays, baby reef sharks and osprey, then snorkel from the kayak over sheltered coral. The operator recommends it for families, with a minimum age of 8.
highlights: Double sit-on-top kayaks in the Bundegi Sanctuary Zone
Turtles, rays, baby reef sharks and osprey are commonly seen
Snorkel from the kayak over sheltered coral gardens
Groups of 4 to 8 guests
trips.departsFrom: Pick up from Exmouth accommodation starting 15 minutes before the tour start time, or meet at the corner of Murat Rd and Yardie Creek Road. Kayaks launch in the Bundegi Sanctuary Zone, Exmouth Gulf, about a 15 minute drive from town

trips.title: Coral By Kayak
trips.summary: A half day trip that paddles out to a snorkel site in the Tantabiddi Sanctuary Zone on Ningaloo Reef, about 30 minutes from the boat ramp. Guests tie up to a kayak-only mooring and snorkel over coral formations and reef fish, then paddle back. The tour leaves from Exmouth by vehicle, with a morning or afternoon start depending on the time of year.

The day includes a swim or snorkel at a Ningaloo beach and a boat cruise through Yardie Creek gorge on the operator's vessel, Spirit of Yardi. Morning tea, lunch and snorkel gear are included.

The route usually runs between Osprey Bay and Ned's Camp.

trips.title: Dampier Archipelago and Murujuga National Park 5-Day Sea Kayak Expedition

It starts with a cultural awareness session and rock art tour led by Murujuga Aboriginal Corporation rangers. Guests need prior multi-day sea kayaking experience, and snorkelling is not a focus.

checkNotes: The website address on our list redirects to the www version, which is where every page was read (23 pages; no captcha or bot check was hit, and the contact form pages carry a form captcha only). Left out of trips, with reasons: (1) Summer Sunset Turtle Watching Tour, a beach-based evening turtle nesting and stargazing tour at Jurabi Coastal Park with no kayaking or boating (3.5 to 4 hours, Adult $165, Children (6-17) $145, Family (2 adults + 2 children) $530, Additional children $125; the tour page says November 15 to February 21 but the home page says December to March; Rezdy product 532151 on the operator's own account); (2) Exmouth Modern History and Heritage Tour, a land-based 4 hour bus tour (Adult $140, Children (6-17) $125 from April 1, 2024; Rezdy product 573773); (3) hire of kayaks, SUPs, surfboards, snorkel gear and wetsuits (snorkel gear from $10 per day), arranged by enquiry form, with multi-day SUP hire stopped from September 2026; (4) custom school, youth and corporate programs, by enquiry only; (5) surf and SUP lessons, which appear in the Terms and Conditions but have no page; (6) whale shark and humpback whale tours and other experiences on the Our Partners page, which are run by other businesses (Ocean Eco Adventures, Kings Ningaloo Reef Tours, Wilderness Island, Bullara Station, Flying Sandgroper). The Weekly Tour Calendar page is an embedded Rezdy calendar for all tours (exmouthadventureco.rezdy.com/productsCalendar/75329), and every trip kept here has its own booking link instead. All prices are in dollars with no currency stated; AUD assumed. Most family prices are for direct bookings only. Phone is shown on the site as +61 (0)477 685 123. The Sustainable Tourism Accredited logo appears in the site footer without naming the accrediting body. The Dampier trip's only dated departures have passed, the Ningaloo Odyssey trekking days are run by Trek Ningaloo, and the 2-Day Campout has no page, price or times; see those trips' notes.
